# Terry Wang

> Personal homepage of Terry Wang — a curious, truth-seeking Linux enthusiast since Fedora Core 1, belive in KISS, technology and Financial Literacy for good courses. Site is self-hosted on a Raspberry Pi 4 running Fedora aarch64.

- Contact: `echo "cm9vdEB0ZXJyeS5pbQo=" | base64 -d`
- Site: [terry.im](https://terry.im)
